notes.title: Update 1.25 - Gallery with all the juicy renders from the game as a reward!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43113582/ec4c4467ef2d4880c26f332bd26beb0476c62c26.pngNew gallery has been added to the game with all the juicy renders! It contains 52 adult images in total and you can access it from the main menu. It unlocks after you complete all the achievements!

Good luck with the achievements and let us know in the discussion if you like the gallery and of course also if you need help with any achievement!
